summary: Implemented LINK-1 connection domain rules and both Dexie and in-memory repositories with duplicate/self-link/provenance validation, unique pair enforcement, strict reads, retype, cascade, restore, and rollback tests; required test and typecheck commands pass.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Implemented LINK-1 connection domain rules and both Dexie and in-memory repositories with duplicate/self-link/provenance validation, unique pair enforcement, strict reads, retype, cascade, restore, and rollback tests; required test and typecheck commands pass.
decisions: Duplicate create returns the existing connection with status 'duplicate' so LINK-3 can select it rather than surfacing an error.
ConnectionRepository owns strict connection reads; CaseRepository.listConnections stays tolerant of corrupt children so card deletion cannot be trapped.
The v1 unique pairKey index remains the race backstop; no migration was added.
interfaces: findConnectionForPair, assertConnectionPairAvailable, planConnectionCascade, findDanglingConnections, missingConnectionEndpoints, DuplicateConnectionError
warnings: LINK-3/LINK-4 must use ConnectionRepository for strict string reads; CaseRepository.listConnections intentionally does not re-check endpoints.
The in-memory connection fake does not track case updatedAt.
validationLimitations: Unique-index race fallback and the internal constraint-recovery lookup are implemented but not directly exercised.
No browser or visual board behavior is in scope for LINK-1.
payload.taskDescription: Create connection domain helpers for unordered pair keys, self-link rejection, duplicate rejection, provenance eligibility (note to source only), association eligibility (any two distinct cards), and cascade plans. Create ConnectionRepository with create, retype, delete, list-by-case, and delete-by-card operations. Enforce the unique pairKey index, validate endpoints exist in the same case, use one transaction per mutation, and expose a test-only in-memory path. Add tests for A-B and B-A duplicates, self-links, provenance misuse, retype, cascade, and dangling endpoint rejection. Do not add Pixi or UI code.
